claims.claim: AWS said Friday it would invest more than $1 billion over five years in U.S. communities where it operates data centers.
claims.episode_span: Amazon Web Services said Friday it will spend more than $1 billion over five years
claims.source_title: Amazon AWS to Invest Over $1bn In US Communities Over Five Years
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS), the cloud computing division of Amazon, said on Friday it would invest more than $1 billion over the next five years in US communities where it operates data centres.

claims.claim: GeekWire reports the community program is called Built Together and includes free community college and energy upgrades, on top of more than $1 billion given over the past three years.
claims.episode_span: a program GeekWire reports is called Built Together
claims.supporting_quote: The company’s new program, which it calls “Built Together,” will fund free community college, job training, energy upgrades for homes and schools

claims.claim: Amazon said it invested $276 billion in data centers between 2011 and 2025, including projects in Indiana, Louisiana, North Carolina, Virginia, and Mississippi.
claims.episode_span: Amazon said it invested $276 billion in data centers between 2011 and 2025
claims.source_title: Amazon AWS to Invest Over $1bn In US Communities Over Five Years
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon said it invested $276 billion in data centres between 2011 and 2025, with major projects and expansions underway in several states, including Indiana, Louisiana, North Carolina, Virginia and Mississippi.

claims.claim: Matt Garman said more than 100 data-center moratoriums are being considered and that countries that lead in AI will shape it.
claims.episode_span: more than 100 data-center moratoriums are being considered
claims.source_title: Amazon AWS to Invest Over $1bn In US Communities Over Five Years
claims.supporting_quote: “There is urgency to this data center buildout because we aren’t the only country that sees the benefits of AI for the economy and national security, and the countries that lead in AI will shape it and get the most from it,” AWS CEO Matt Garman said.

claims.claim: Amazon said it will drop NDAs with agencies on data-center projects, use lower-emission backup generators, publish energy and water use yearly, and pay enough for power so local bills do not rise.
claims.episode_span: stop using nondisclosure agreements with government agencies on data-center projects
claims.source_title: Amazon pledges $1B to data center communities, warns that local opposition threatens U.S. AI lead
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon also says it will stop using NDAs with government agencies on data center projects, install lower-emission backup generators at new sites, publish its energy and water use each year, and pay enough for power to keep local electricity bills from rising.

claims.claim: AWS pledged to be water positive by 2030 and said it has reached 75 percent of the progress toward that target.
claims.episode_span: water positive across its data centers by 2030
claims.source_title: Amazon AWS to Invest Over $1bn In US Communities Over Five Years
claims.supporting_quote: AWS also pledged to become water positive across its data centres by 2030, meaning it aims to return more water to communities than it uses.
